Question: Any person comming from India for Haj must do Qurbani here (S.A) but same time they must do Qurbani in India also. Answer ID: 8403 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1973/1581=H/1429) The Qurbani which is levied due to hajj (like Dum of Tamattu, Qiran, Ihsar and Janabah) is necessary to be offered in the Haram only, while the obligatory Qurbani due to wealth can be offered anywhere whether in the Haram or oneÂ’s own country (India etc). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
